indications: This product is indicated for use in the topical control of acne vulgaris, acne rosacea and seborrheic dermatitis.
contraindications: Shake well before using. Cleanse affected areas. Apply a thin layer to the affected areas with light massaging, 1 to 3 times daily or as directed by a physician.
